So Rust has changed quite a bit in the past few months so building strategies have also changed. What are some of your anti raider strategies?

One that I always do with a group is make "ready rooms" where everyone has their own room with a sleeping bag and a box full of guns, ammo, grenades, gear, health items, etc so that not only is our stuff locked away from raiders but if you get surprised and killed near your base you aren't shit out of luck.

I also like to build small 3x3x2 buildings randomly and put furnaces at the top running full of wood and nothing else in it but make it absurdly difficult to get into and fill with traps so that not only do raiders feel enticed by the sound of furnaces but they waste their resources getting in and possibly die from the traps.
What are your anti-raider strategies in the current Rust?

Clever tactics. I play solo, mostly, so I have a different strategy.

I completely decentralize my belongings. I'll start out by immediately making my stone tools, then my basic spear and clothes. Once I do that I stash a chest, furnace and sleeping bag somewhere, but always separated by about 15 seconds of waking. This way I have a spawn point near a chest and furnace, but finding one doesn't always mean finding the other.

I'll do this 3 or four times; each chest will have stone wood and cloth to start. Once I have a good spread of hideouts, I'll do some barrel runs to hunt for blueprints. I usually try to find the large chest and some kind of ranged weapon, either HV arrows or a gun /bulletcombo.

Once I have this gear I make small bases dotted around the map. I try to make them hidden. Generally I'll have around 7 hidey holes and 5 satellite bases.

If I eventually get real swole, I'll build a bunker, a 5x5 or 7x7 metal box.

My main priority is being able to do solo harassment raids on groups of 2 to 4. Since in so decentralized, hurting me is difficult, so I'll hide in rocks and pick aggressive groups to harass. Snipe then from hills, place bear traps and now land mines in their bushes and shit.

Keeping the raiders power checked will help you not get raided. Try not to get the finishing blow on someone, especially if they're downed. Since that tells then who killed you. Build confusing bases, hide your loot. That sortf thing.

That's pretty interesting. I never play solo but I may need to give it a try on a vanilla server sometime just for the hell of it and give your strategy a try.

Since I play in a group I always keep a contingency box with guns, a little C4, and enough mats to build a new place, hidden in a remote area of the map that no one is gonna stumble across on accident just in case someone betrays us so that we (or I) are not up shit creek. Not that it happens much but sometimes infighting happens and I've had people fuck the group over so I like to have a backup plan. It's also nice for if you get raided hard.

I like the strategy of keeping raiding groups in check. We tend to do a similar thing except we will go find someone's base and make note of where it is that way if someone starts getting too big for their britches we can go find them and their house and make their life difficult until either we wipe them from the map or they chill out.
